_comment: Regression rules for scripts/compare-benchmarks.mjs. Ratios are current divided by reference, so above 1 is slower.
_suiteComment: A broad uniform slowdown can leave every individual case under its own limit while still costing real throughput. Injecting a context object into the VM dispatch path is exactly that shape, which is why the geometric mean across a suite has its own tighter bound.
_improvementComment: A report that only ever delivers bad news stops being read. Improvements past this are called out.
_noiseComment: Below this the number is timer resolution plus loop overhead rather than the work being measured, so a ratio computed from it is meaningless. Several existing cases sit here. Milliseconds, so this is 5 microseconds.
